title: Bound every-policy excess above m and complete the joint expected-stopping KL interface
statement: In the original source-only whole-product model, target-multiset conservation gives K+(N_Q-m)>=m TV(empX,empfirstmQ) pathwise. At P=Q uniform the right-side expectation is m delta(d,m), while E K<=m eta, hence E N_Q>=m+m(delta-eta); combine N_Q>=m to obtain C*>=m+m(delta-eta)_+. Therefore eta<delta forces a strictly positive gap for EVERY policy and its infimum, without any compactness/attainment premise. The accepted exact worst empirical excess theorem plus matcher gives C*=m iff eta>=delta, delta=d E|Bin(m,1/d)-Bin_prime(m,1/d)|/(2m). Separately, the accepted log-free Omega(d/eta) proof is completed by including joint side information (uniform J,the ENTIRE actual old vector X,all signs except its selected pair): this side information has identical law under selected-label deficit/surplus. Stopped KL is applied to the augmented joint laws, then marginalized to the disagreement event. Its averaged4eta/2eta event bounds need NOT hold pointwise given every side-information value. Bounded per-Q log ratios pay arbitrary finite expected stopping, P replies give zero information, and deficit-conditioned mean<=2 times worst fixed-law mean. No new hardcap/exponential-moment/analytical replacement of the actual old row is introduced. Full positive excess and intermediate-regime minimax remain OPEN.

P1 selected Extra High at dispatch, but later selector showed Medium: effective setting THROUGHOUT UNCONFIRMED; no causal model comparison. Expected-stopping KL proof uses a paired-sign hard family and the actual original row, not an independent replacement. Full all-regime minimax and sharp positive excess remain OPEN. No practical workload, physical advantage or priority claim. No ZIP identified. All source/access/transfer/resource holds persist; native model retrieval remains unverified/unretried. ROOT clarifies that augmented side information (J,WHOLE actual X,all other pair signs) has the SAME law in the two hypotheses. Averaged disagreement bounds are NOT asserted pointwise for every side-information value. The quantitative conservation bound supersedes any need for the earlier separate compactness argument; the original immutable proof remains historical. Root acceptance is at the supplied scope, not a new Capital audit.
costs: Supplied old m acquisition/storage and m output labels are charged in an end-to-end application. Hybrid L=ceil(1/eta), N=max(m,ceil((d-1)/eta^2)) chooses new-call mean min{m[1+2d(L-1)],2N-m}. With B=bits(d,m,a,b),eta=a/b,S=B+m ceil(log2 d),H=1+B+ceil(log2(N+2))+ceil(log2(d+2)), source supplies expected local bit work <=C0(S+B^3+NH^3) and memory O(S+N(log(N+2)+log(d+2))); fair-bit integer rejection expected work and parameter construction included. Physical oracle implementation costs remain separately unspecified. ROOT delta is an exact finite rational O(m^2)-term binomial sum with O(m log d+log m)-bit integers; explicit m-list costs are not polylog m.
